name: Mountain Ink
description: Ink-wash landscape on rice paper: white xuan-paper ground, ink-green accent, Ming-style serif CJK headlines, a self-contained mountain backdrop dialled to three pressure levels (full-bleed / chapter / faint), and a single cinnabar seal as the one warm note.
descriptionZh: 白宣紙底＋墨綠 accent＋明體中文大標；自帶三張山水底圖（滿版／扉頁／內頁三段氣壓，可換成自己的圖），朱砂印章是全場唯一的暖色點綴。
